# vendor

`tiptap.js` is built from `editor/` by the "Editor bundle" GitHub Actions workflow. Don't edit it by hand: change `editor/src/index.js` or `editor/package.json`, push, and the workflow rebuilds and commits it.

It contains [TipTap](https://tiptap.dev) and [ProseMirror](https://prosemirror.net), both MIT licensed.
